description.value: Dawson's Hot Dogs is a takeout-only hot dog stand located at or immediately outside BC Place Stadium in downtown Vancouver. With no indoor or outdoor seating, it operates as a quick-service kiosk, making it a fast bite option for cyclists passing through the False Creek and stadium district. Its stadium-adjacent location means it likely serves event crowds as well as passers-by on the nearby seawall cycling routes.
